kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem update-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --alert-uuid 'sas_71e24437d2797ce8fc59692905a4****' --alert-status 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAlert

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center for threat analysis is located. You must select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Select this value if your assets are located in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Select this value if your assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert associated with the event
parameters.name: alert_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:
0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type
